name: GNU FreeDink
description:
GNU FreeDink is a free, portable open-source reimplementation of Dink Smallwood, the comedic action-RPG originally released by Robinson Technologies in 1997. It replaces the proprietary game engine to run smoothly on modern hardware.

Features:
- Faithful reproduction of Dink Smallwood's real-time action combat and quest dialogues
- Complete compatibility with official campaigns and thousands of community D-Mods
- Native cross-platform engine with scalable graphics and smooth performance
- Enhanced sound playback utilizing modern digital audio libraries
- Includes free data replacement package for open distribution
